overall.verdict: The desktop-dark variant demonstrates strong design execution with excellent consistency, trust cues, and data legibility. The visceral value principle is well-implemented but could be more prominent in certain screens. Typography and color usage are exemplary, creating a premium, calm experience.
priority_fixes: Increase the prominence of visceral value bars across all screens, especially home and activity
Improve the scale visualization in settings with larger examples
Enhance the visibility of frame numbers in receipts for better provability
Standardize the presentation of limits - remove redundant text when bars are present
Increase font sizes for critical information like receive limits and activity counters
